cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Apologize for the Lie
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that the concealment or misdirection mattered, even if the underlying choice was defensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'm not asking you to apologise for cancelling. Apologise for not telling me. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't want to upset you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. So you let me arrive with a cake instead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry the party didn't happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Try the part where I didn't know.
